# AquaClean

> AquaClean — a factory-direct OEM/ODM manufacturer of home cleaning appliances 
(robot vacuums, cordless vacuums, floor scrubbers, steam cleaners, tire inflators and more).
> Legal entity: Hong Kong Damaijia Technology Co., Limited. Factory established 2015 (Ningbo, China); 
> Hong Kong company established 2024. Website: https://www.hkdmj.net

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It helps AI assistants find and
cite authoritative pages. Each linked page carries full, crawlable FAQ content
and machine-readable schema.org structured data.
